GO-002.summary: Catalog search scans in-memory domain slice; needs pg_trgm or full-text index for enterprise catalog sizes

GO-004.summary: Exhaustive store enumeration complexity grows with O(N^2); acceptable for small networks, requires pruning for large retailer networks

GO-005.summary: Docker CLI not installed on host machine; local development operates cleanly via system PostgreSQL service

GO-006.summary: Open Prices ecosystem lacks sufficient geographic density in US suburban regions (0 overlapping products across stores in SE Michigan); addressed via Path B user observations

GO-007.summary: Unprotected observation modification and cross-contributor overwrite vulnerability resolved via SHA-256 capability edit tokens (X-Edit-Token)

GO-008.summary: Physical store identity collisions resolved via composite locality model (brand, address, city, state, zip_code) and unresolved location flagging

GO-009.summary: High price entry friction resolved via Shopping Trip multi-item batch entry mode (>55% action reduction) and recent store caching

GO-010.summary: Same-ZIP store collisions when street address is omitted resolved by creating isolated unresolved-location store records

GO-011.summary: Observation PATCH flow discarding known store locality corrected to preserve existing physical address, city, state, zip, and coordinates

GO-012.summary: Public observation endpoints protected via sliding window rate limiter (60/min single, 20/min batch) and atomic transactional batch validation
